description: This PHP source file defines the ScopeRepository class in the SuiteCRM OAuth2 API module. It implements methods for retrieving scope entities by identifier and finalizing scope lists, primarily to manage OAuth2 scope entities for SuiteCRM's OAuth2 server integration.

classes.name: ScopeRepository
classes.description: Repository class implementing scope retrieval and management for OAuth2 authorization in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getScopeEntityByIdentifier
methods.description: Returns a ScopeEntity object corresponding to the given scope identifier if it exists; otherwise null.

methods.name: finalizeScopes
methods.description: Finalizes and returns the list of scopes, potentially modified based on grant type, client, or user context.
